an7.50:1.1: XLVII. Atha kho Jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ . . . pe . . . etad avoca ‘bhavam pi no Gotamo brahmacārī paṭijānātī' ti. ‘Yaṃ hi taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya "akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caratī" ti; mam' eva taṃ brāhmaṇa sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa akhaṇḍaṃ acchiddaṃ asabalaṃ akammāsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carāmī' ti. ‘Kiṃ pana bho Gotama brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pī' ti?
an7.50:2.1: Idha brāhmaṇa ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammābrahmacārī paṭijānamāno na h' eva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati. So taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. Idam pi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pi. Ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.50:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ brāhmaṇa idh' ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammābrahmacārī paṭijānamāno na h' eva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayandvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, na pi mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananahāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati, api ca kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati . . . pe . . .
an7.50:4.1: na pi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkeḷāyati, api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati . . . na
an7.50:5.1: pi mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati, api ca kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā . . . na
an7.50:6.1: pi mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuḍḍaṃ vā tiropākāraṃ vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā, api ca kho yāni 'ssa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni anussarati . . . na
an7.50:7.1: pi yāni' ssa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni anussarati, api ca kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ . . . na
an7.50:8.1: pi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgibhūtaṃ paricāriyamānaṃ, api ca kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā' ti. So taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. Idam pi kho brāhmaṇa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍam pi chiddam pi sabalam pi kammāsam pi. Ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmi.
an7.50:9.1: Yāvakīvañ cāhaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ samanupassiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ,
an7.50:10.1: yato ca kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa imesaṃ sattannaṃ methunasaṃyogānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ methunasaṃyogaṃ attani appahīnaṃ na samanupassiṃ, athāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ. Ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi ‘akuppā me cetovimutti, ayam antimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo' ti.
an7.50:11.1: Evaṃ vutte Jānussoṇī brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca ‘abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama . . . pe . . . upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan' ti.
